subject.title: refactor(delivery): prevent duplicate and lost scheduled deliveries

question: Should maintainers accept this broad SQLite delivery-lifecycle refactor as the canonical fix after owner-led merge-head proof, or require a narrower scoped repair?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label and cross-cutting changes to durable delivery, recovery, and media custody make the acceptable risk boundary a maintainer decision rather than a mechanical follow-up.

options.title: Require owner-led merge-head proof
options.body: Rebase the branch, resolve the failed and pending checks, and attach redacted live scheduled-delivery and restart/recovery evidence before considering merge.

options.title: Request a narrower repair
options.body: Keep the existing queue model and split only the demonstrated duplicate/loss defect into a smaller change if maintainers do not want to adopt the broader ownership lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Require owner-led merge-head proof
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, resolve the failed and pending checks, and attach redacted live scheduled-delivery and restart/recovery evidence before considering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The current branch history shows direct authorship of the proposed delivery ownership model.
